slug: 2025-02-28 Enhancing healthcare performance in Ethiopia using DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health began full national implementation of the DHIS2-based national HMIS in 2017 and trained more than 7,000 workers, on the HISP Centre's account.
The DHIS2-based national HMIS reached all of the country's 30,000+ public health facilities by 2024, on the HISP Centre's account; the document names no tiers, only all public facilities.
The Ministry of Health reported at the 2025 Global DPI Summit in Cape Town that the national DHIS2 system held more than 1 billion records, with data from 30,000+ health facilities.
